translations.web: He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.
translations.bsb: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD, and he worked extensively on the wall at the hill of Ophel.
translations.kjv: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
